svg.title: Sheet 7 - Event cards 10-18, 63 x 88 mm (A4)
svg.desc: The second half of the Event deck. Cards 10-16 carry the seven habitus parts sheet 6 does not cover; cards 17 and 18 have no HERO route at all.

g.text: Work played on it this week:
Built years ago. Nobody wrote down why.
Only the chart changed, not the work.
All of it is the top priority.
none is, lose a card and
No one person can be the answer.
This one is not about any of you.
